description: This Java source file defines a class 'ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy' which is responsible for handling substitutions for access control lists and policies within 'ModifyThing' commands. It extends an abstract substitution strategy and manages JSON modifications related to policies and things, utilizing various imported classes and models.

classes.name: ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending an abstract substitution strategy, responsible for substituting elements within 'ModifyThing' commands, especially policies and headers.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs substitution on a 'ModifyThing' object, handling policies and things, and returning an updated 'WithDittoHeaders' object if modifications are applied.

methods.name: substituteInitialPolicy
methods.description: Parses an initial policy JSON object, substitutes policy elements if possible, and returns the resulting JSON object.
